senses.gloss: ललाट- + पट्ट ललाट- + पट्ट, the forehead, Pañc. 35, 2.
ललित-अर्थ- + बन्ध ललित-अर्थ- + बन्ध, adj. composed in verses treating of love, Vikr. d. 32.
ललित-पद- + बन्धन ललित-पद- + बन्धन, n. a composition in verses treating of love, Śāk. 36, 16 (Prākṛ.).

लल् लल्, and † लड् लड्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry, Ātm., Rām. 1, 9, 19).
 1. To sport, MBh. 3, 1741.
 2. To dally, Rām. 1, 9, 19.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. ललित.
 1. Dallying, wanton, Megh. 65.
 2. Beautiful, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 6.
 3. Wished. n.
 1. Beauty, Rām. 1, 9, 16.
 2. Love of pleasure, love, Vikr. d. 32.
 3. Softness and delicacy of motion, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 6.
 4. ˚तम्, adv. Sweetly, Dev. 10, 27.
 --Comp.
 --Caus., and i. 10, Par.
 A. ललय, † लडय,
 1. To exhilarate, Rām. 2, 43, 5.
 2. To nurse, to foster, to attend, Rām. 2, 47, 6; Pañc. 87, 11.
 B. लालय,
 1. To cherish, Pañc. i. d. 397.
 2. To spoil, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2664.
 --i. 10, Ātm. † लाडय, To desire. लालित,
 1. Desired.
 2. Cherished tenderly, Pañc. iii. d. 126.
 3. Loved, Rājat. 5, 6.
 4. Coaxed, Pañc. 87, 11 (or n. Joy; ˚तेन, Joyfully ?).
 5. Seduced; cf. 2. लड्.
 --With the prep. उप उप, Caus. लालय,
 1. To court, Mālav. 29, 1.
 2. To fondle, Śāk. 104, 5.

ललज्जिह्व ललज्जिह्व, i. e. ललन्त्-जिह्व (see 2. लड् and जिह्वा),
 I. adj. Fierce, savage.
 II. m.
 1. A camel.
 2. A dog.

ललन ललन, i. e. लड्, and लल् + अन,
 I. m.
 1. A tree, Shorea robusta.
 2. A boy.
 II. f. ना.
 1. A wanton woman, Indr. 5, 6.
 2. A woman in general, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 27.
 III. n.
 1. Sport, pleasure.
 2. Lolling the tongue.

लालन लालन, also लाडन, Cāṇ. 84 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 412, i. e. लल्, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Coaxing, Rājat. 5, 290.
 2. Spoiling, over-indulging, Pañc. i. d. 185.
ललन्तिका ललन्तिका (akin to लल्), f. A necklace reaching to the navel.

ललाट ललाट, n. The forehead, Pañc. ii. d. 183; Vikr. 73, 8.
 --Comp.
ललाटंतप ललाट्ं-तप, i. e. ललाट + म्-तप् + अ, adj. Burning the forehead, Utt. Rāmac. 153, 5; Mālat. 12, 8.

ललाटिका ललाटिका, i. e. ललाट + क, f.
 1. An ornament worn on the forehead, as a jewel.
 2. A mark made with sandal on the forehead, Pāṇ. iv. 3, 65.

लालाटिक लालाटिक, i. e. ललाट + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to the forehead, worn on it, etc.
 2. Contemplating the forehead.
 3. Relating to fate (which is supposed to be written on one's forehead).
 4. Low.
 II. m., and f. की.
 1. An attentive servant.
 2. An idler.

ललाम ललाम (akin to लल्),
 I. n., [] also ललामन् ललामन्,
 1. A mark.
 2. A flag.
 3. An ornament, Śāk. 25, 4.
 4. A mane.
 5. A tail.
 6. A line.
 7. Majesty, dignity.
 8. Chief, principal, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 18.
 II. f. मी, An ornament worn in the ear.
ललामक ललाम + क, n. A chaplet of flowers falling over the forehead, Pāṇ. iv. 4, 40.
ललितादित्य ललितादित्य, i. e. ललित-आदित्य, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 69.
लल्लिय लल्लिय, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 154.
लालक लालक, i. e. लल्, Caus., + अक, adj., f. लिका. Seducing, Nal. 2, 28.

लालस लालस, i. e. लालस्, frequent. of 1. लस्, but partly in the signification of लष्, + अ, m., and f. सा.
 1. Ardent desire. Bhartṛ. 3, 36 (m.); Pañc. 81, 21 [] (at the end of a comp. adj. श्रवण-सुख-, Ardently desiring the pleasure for his ears).
 2. Regret.
 3. Asking.
 4. The longing of a pregnant woman.
 5. Dalliance, MBh. 7, 3383 (?).
 --Comp.
लाला लाला (akin to ली), f. Saliva, spittle, Bhartṛ. 2, 9; Ṛt. 1, 5.
लालाय लालाय, a denomin. derived from लाला with य, Ātm. To secrete saliva continually, Pañc. iii. d. 195.
लालितक लालित + क (see लल्, Caus.), m. A favourite, Rājat. 6, 166.
लालित्य लालित्य, i. e. ललित + य (vb. लल्), n. Loveliness.
लाला- + विष लाला- + विष, m. an insect whose spittle is poison, as a spider.
लाला- + स्राव लाला- + स्राव, m. a spider.
